name: peloton-pp-mcp
description: Workout, ride, and music history from your Peloton account in the terminal. First catalog CLI to harvest the Auth0 SPA bearer token from a browser session, then mirror history into a local SQLite store with FTS5 search.

peloton_username.title: PELOTON_USERNAME
peloton_username.description: Peloton account email or username consumed by `auth login` to pre-fill the Auth0 sign-in form. Optional — you can sign in by hand inside the spawned Chrome window. Pass inline-scope only (do not export); `auth_simple.go.tmpl AuthHeader()` precedence currently treats this as a candidate bearer token.

peloton_password.title: PELOTON_PASSWORD
peloton_password.description: Peloton account password consumed by `auth login` to pre-fill the Auth0 sign-in form. Optional. Inline-scope only.

peloton_token.title: PELOTON_TOKEN
peloton_token.description: Bearer token populated automatically by `auth login` (extracted from Auth0 SPA localStorage); read by authenticated commands. Do not set manually — use `auth login` instead. Lifetime ~1 hour Peloton-side.
